# HANGMAN - Lindsay R. Ford - DREAMER 12 p.9-10 (PDF pages 11-12) - CHIP-8 0080-0421 (printed 0080-0430)
# load 0080, run C000 (FN 3). Two players. The 'hangman' presses 5, 6, 7 or 8 = word length; a square is
# shown per letter and the count at the right. He then keys each letter as a two-key T.V. Typewriter
# code on the hex keypad: A=0A B=0B ... F=0F, G=10 ... V=1F, W=20 X=21 Y=22 Z=23. Each accepted letter
# lowers the count; a wrong code beeps and shows a cross. Then the 'victim' keys letters (same codes):
# correct letters appear in place, each miss adds a part of the hanged man; as many misses as letters
# = hanged (the word is then shown); guessing the word wins a 'reprieve'.
# 1K systems: leave out 0400-0422 and change 0294 to 1200 (article). ASCII keyboard version (article):
# 0290 FE18 2342 1400 07F0 70C9 12AC 0000 0000 / 02A0 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 6109 8105
# (needs the keyboard routine at 0700-07FF, not applied here).
# No corrections: transcribed as printed.
